title: Ancestor Launcher
text: Place the arquebus in the assembly bench's center and the upgrade components around it. Each gun accepts only one upgrade kit. Its loaded spell crystal remains installed, and black-red patterns appear along the barrel.

Spell power becomes an additive +50% of base power, and the base firing interval becomes 3 seconds. While held in the main hand, every 3 seconds it spends a fixed 10 mana to grant 5 seconds of invisibility. Insufficient mana stops renewal; putting the gun away lets the remaining invisibility expire naturally.

Projectiles burst on impact within 1.7 blocks, spreading their carried spell effects. Spell power increases damage, not this added radius. Allies and the shooter are not exempt; the direct target is not affected twice. Reflected projectiles retain the effect.
